<section class="module" id="reference">
<div class="module-hd"><h2>How to Play &amp; Embedded Reference Search</h2></div>
<div class="module-body">
<div class="grid3">
<div class="subbox"><h3>Ability Check</h3><p>d20 + ability modifier + proficiency when a skill/tool applies. Meet or beat the DC.</p></div>
<div class="subbox"><h3>Saving Throw</h3><p>d20 + the listed saving throw modifier. Meet or beat the effect’s DC.</p></div>
<div class="subbox"><h3>Attack Roll</h3><p>d20 + attack bonus. Meet or beat the target’s AC. On a hit, roll listed damage.</p></div>
<div class="subbox"><h3>Advantage / Disadvantage</h3><p>Roll two d20s and use the higher or lower result. One of each cancels.</p></div>
<div class="subbox"><h3>Spell Save</h3><p>The target rolls the named save against your displayed spell save DC.</p></div>
<div class="subbox"><h3>Concentration</h3><p>Track one concentration spell at a time. Damage can require a Constitution saving throw to maintain it.</p></div>
</div>

function secureDie(sides=6){if(globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues){const range=0x100000000,limit=Math.floor(range/sides)*sides,b=new Uint32Array(1);do{globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(b);}while(b[0]>=limit);return b[0]%sides+1;}return Math.floor(Math.random()*sides)+1;}

 if(L('Fighter')){const l=L('Fighter');const max=e==='5.5e'?(l<4?2:l<10?3:4):1;out.push({id:'secondwind',name:'Second Wind',max,short:e==='5.5e'?'one':'all'});}
 if(L('Monk')>=2)out.push({id:'focus',name:e==='5.5e'?'Focus Points':'Ki Points',max:L('Monk'),short:'all'});
 if(L('Paladin'))out.push({id:'layhands',name:'Lay On Hands pool',max:5*L('Paladin'),short:'none'});
 if(e==='5.5e'&&L('Ranger')){const l=L('Ranger');const max=l<5?2:l<9?3:l<13?4:l<17?5:6;out.push({id:'favoredenemy',name:'Favored Enemy free casts',max,short:'none'});}
 if(L('Sorcerer')>=2)out.push({id:'sorcery',name:'Sorcery Points',max:L('Sorcerer'),short:'none'});
 return out;}

function findSpell(q){q=q.trim().toLowerCase();const id=DB.spells.indexes.by_name[q];if(id)return DB.spells.catalog[id];return Object.values(DB.spells.catalog).find(s=>String(s.display_name||'').toLowerCase()===q||String(s.canonical_name||'').toLowerCase()===q)||null;}
function spellClassMath(cls){const d=classData(cls);if(!d||!d.spell_ability)return null;const am=abilityMod(d.spell_ability);return{dc:8+pb()+am,attack:pb()+am,ability:d.spell_ability};}
function howToRollSpell(s,cls){const math=spellClassMath(cls);const desc=String(s.description||'');let lines=[];if(/spell attack/i.test(desc)){lines.push(math?`Roll d20 ${fmt(math.attack)} for a spell attack against the target's AC.`:'Roll a spell attack using the granted feature or item bonus.');}const save=desc.match(/(Strength|Dexterity|Constitution|Intelligence|Wisdom|Charisma) saving throw/i);if(save)lines.push(math?`Target rolls a ${save[1]} saving throw against DC ${math.dc}.`:`Target rolls a ${save[1]} saving throw against the applicable DC.`);if(!lines.length)lines.push('No attack roll or saving throw is identified in the imported description; follow the spell text.');const dice=[...desc.matchAll(/\b\d+d\d+(?:\s*[+-]\s*\d+)?\b/gi)].slice(0,4).map(x=>x[0]);if(dice.length)lines.push('Common dice expressions in the description: '+[...new Set(dice)].join(', ')+'.');return lines.join(' ');}

function updateSimpleFields(){const direct={languages:'languages',proficiencies:'proficiencies',concentrating:'concentrating',concentrationName:'concentrationName',exhaustion:'exhaustion'};Object.entries(direct).forEach(([k,id])=>{const el=$(id);if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=!!state[k];else el.value=state[k]??'';});const combatMap=['armorMode','armorBase','shieldBonus','miscAC','acOverride','initiativeMisc','initiativeProficient','initiativeAdvantage','speedMisc'];combatMap.forEach(k=>{const el=$(k);if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=!!state.combat[k];else el.value=state.combat[k]??'';});$('currentHP').value=state.hp.current;$('tempHP').value=state.hp.temp;$('otherHPBonus').value=state.hp.otherBonus;$('deathSuccess').value=state.death.success;$('deathFailure').value=state.death.failure;$('stable').value=state.death.stable?'1':'0';Object.entries(state.conditions).forEach(([n,v])=>{const el=document.querySelector(`[data-condition="${CSS.escape(n)}"]`);if(el)el.checked=!!v;});Object.entries(state.coins).forEach(([k,v])=>$('coin'+k.toUpperCase()).value=v);Object.entries(state.notes).forEach(([k,v])=>$(k).value=v);updateArtworkPreviews();}
function updateRaceSummary(){const r=effectiveRaceRecord();if(!r){$('raceSummary').textContent=state.profile.race==='__writein__'?'Custom race/species: DM approval required. function renderSummary(){const lvl=totalLevel();$('summaryName').textContent=state.profile.characterName||'Unnamed Adventurer';$('summaryLine').textContent=lvl?`Level ${lvl} • ${classSummary()}`:'Level 0 • Choose a starting class';$('summaryIdentity').textContent=[currentRaceName(),currentGender(),currentPronouns()].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')||'Race/species not selected';$('sumAC').textContent=computeAC();$('sumHP').textContent=computedMaxHP();$('sumPB').textContent=fmt(pb());$('sumInit').textContent=fmt(initiativeTotal());$('acDisplay').textContent=computeAC();$('initiativeDisplay').textContent=fmt(initiativeTotal())+(state.combat.initiativeAdvantage?' (Adv.)':'');$('speedDisplay').textContent=baseSpeed()+num(state.combat.speedMisc);$('passivePerception').textContent=10+skillTotal('Perception');$('maxHP').value=computedMaxHP();$('carryCapacity').value=(finalScore('Strength')*15*sizeCarryMultiplier())+' lb.';$('pushCapacity').value=(finalScore('Strength')*30*sizeCarryMultiplier())+' lb.';$('hitDiceRemaining').value=state.classes.map(c=>`${num(c.hitDiceRemaining??c.level)}d${classData(c.name).hit_die}`).join(' + ')||'0';
 const lvlNow=totalLevel();const xp=num(state.profile.xp);if(!lvlNow){$('xpHelp').textContent='Initialize a class to begin level tracking.';$('xpBar').style.width='0%';}else if(lvlNow>=20){$('xpHelp').textContent='Level 20 reached.';$('xpBar').style.width='100%';}else{const cur=num(DB.character_engine.xp_thresholds_for_level[String(lvlNow)]),next=num(DB.character_engine.xp_thresholds_for_level[String(lvlNow+1)]);const pct=clamp((xp-cur)/(next-cur)*100,0,100);$('xpBar').style.width=pct+'%';$('xpHelp').textContent=xp>=next?`Eligible for level ${lvlNow+1}. Use Level Up.`:`${Math.max(0,next-xp).toLocaleString()} XP to level ${lvlNow+1}.`;}
 const e=num(state.exhaustion);$('exhaustionHelp').textContent=edition()==='5.5e'?(e?`5.5e exhaustion ${e}: subtract ${e*2} from D20 Tests and reduce Speed by ${e*5} ft.; death at level 6.`:'No exhaustion penalties.'):(['No exhaustion penalties.','Disadvantage on ability checks.','Speed halved.','Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.','Hit point maximum halved.','Speed reduced to 0.','Death.'][e]||'');
 const totalGP=num(state.coins.cp)/100+num(state.coins.sp)/10+num(state.coins.ep)/2+num(state.coins.gp)+num(state.coins.pp)*10;$('coinTotal').value=totalGP.toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/,'')+' gp';
}

 const profileMap={characterName:'characterName',playerName:'playerName',campaignName:'campaignName',edition:'edition',raceSelect:'race',raceWriteIn:'raceWriteIn',raceOption:'raceOption',raceOptionWriteIn:'raceOptionWriteIn',genderIdentity:'genderIdentity',genderWriteIn:'genderWriteIn',pronouns:'pronouns',pronounsWriteIn:'pronounsWriteIn',alignment:'alignment',backgroundSelect:'background',backgroundWriteIn:'backgroundWriteIn',deitySelect:'deity',deityWriteIn:'deityWriteIn',sizeSelect:'size',xp:'xp',inspiration:'inspiration',heroicInspiration:'heroicInspiration'};

Continue?')){state.profile.edition=oldEdition;renderAll();return;}if(k==='edition'){state.profile.race='';state.profile.raceOption='';ABILITIES.forEach(a=>state.abilities[a].origin=0);state.abilityRolls=blankAbilityRollState();}if(k==='race'){state.profile.raceOption='';state.profile.raceOptionWriteIn='';if(state.profile.race!=='__writein__')state.profile.raceWriteIn='';applyRacePhysicalDefaults(true);applyRaceOriginBonuses();maybeAutoGenerateAbilityScores('race/species selection');}if(k==='raceOption'){applyRacePhysicalDefaults(true);applyRaceOriginBonuses();maybeAutoGenerateAbilityScores('race/species option selection');}renderAll();scheduleSave();}));

 $('deathSuccess').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.death.success=num(e.target.value);scheduleSave();});$('deathFailure').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.death.failure=num(e.target.value);scheduleSave();});$('stable').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.death.stable=e.target.value==='1';scheduleSave();});

function handleDelegatedInput(e){const t=e.target,i=num(t.dataset.index);if(t.dataset.saveMisc){state.saves[t.dataset.saveMisc].misc=num(t.value);renderSaves();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.saveProf){state.saves[t.dataset.saveProf].proficient=t.checked;renderSaves();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.skillAbility){state.skills[t.dataset.skillAbility].ability=t.value;renderSkills();renderSummary();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.skillRank){state.skills[t.dataset.skillRank].rank=num(t.value);renderSkills();renderSummary();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.skillMisc){state.skills[t.dataset.skillMisc].misc=num(t.value);renderSkills();renderSummary();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.classSubclass){const c=state.classes.find(x=>x.name===t.dataset.classSubclass);if(c)c.subclass=t.value;renderClasses();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.hitdiceClass){const c=state.classes.find(x=>x.name===t.dataset.hitdiceClass);if(c)c.hitDiceRemaining=clamp(num(t.value),0,c.level);renderSummary();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.attack){state.attacks[i][t.dataset.attack]=t.type==='checkbox'?t.checked:(t.type==='number'?num(t.value):t.value);renderAttacks();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.spell){state.spells[i][t.dataset.spell]=t.type==='checkbox'?t.checked:t.value;renderSpells();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.item){state.items[i][t.dataset.item]=t.type==='checkbox'?t.checked:(t.type==='number'?num(t.value):t.value);renderItems();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.customResource){state.customResources[i][t.dataset.customResource]=t.type==='number'?num(t.value):t.value;scheduleSave();}}
function handleDelegatedClick(e){const t=e.target;if(t.dataset.resourceUse){state.resourceSpent[t.dataset.resourceUse]=num(state.resourceSpent[t.dataset.resourceUse])+1;renderResources();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.resourceRecover){state.resourceSpent[t.dataset.resourceRecover]=Math.max(0,num(state.resourceSpent[t.dataset.resourceRecover])-1);renderResources();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.removeCustomResource!==undefined){state.customResources.splice(num(t.dataset.removeCustomResource),1);renderResources();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.removeAttack!==undefined){state.attacks.splice(num(t.dataset.removeAttack),1);renderAttacks();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.slotUse){const l=num(t.dataset.slotUse);if(num(state.spellSlotsSpent[l])<sharedSlotMax(l))state.spellSlotsSpent[l]=num(state.spellSlotsSpent[l])+1;renderCasting();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.slotRecover){const l=num(t.dataset.slotRecover);state.spellSlotsSpent[l]=Math.max(0,num(state.spellSlotsSpent[l])-1);renderCasting();scheduleSave();}if(t.hasAttribute('data-pact-use')){if(state.pactSlotsSpent<pactInfo().slots)state.pactSlotsSpent++;renderCasting();scheduleSave();}if(t.hasAttribute('data-pact-recover')){state.pactSlotsSpent=Math.max(0,state.pactSlotsSpent-1);renderCasting();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.removeSpell!==undefined){state.spells.splice(num(t.dataset.removeSpell),1);renderSpells();scheduleSave();}if(t.dataset.showSpell!==undefined)showSpell(num(t.dataset.showSpell));if(t.dataset.castSpell!==undefined)castSpell(num(t.dataset.castSpell));if(t.dataset.removeItem!==undefined){state.items.splice(num(t.dataset.removeItem),1);renderItems();scheduleSave();}}
function initializeStartingClass(){if(state.classes.length){alert('A starting class is already initialized. Use New Character or import a corrected character file to replace it.');return;}const name=$('startingClass').value;if(!name){alert('Choose a starting class.');return;}state.startingClass=name;applyRaceOriginBonuses();maybeAutoGenerateAbilityScores('class initialization');const d=classData(name);let raw=d.hit_die;if($('startingHpMode').value==='manual'){raw=clamp(num($('startingHpManual').value),1,d.hit_die);if(!raw){alert('Enter a valid raw Hit Die result.');return;}}state.startingClass=name;state.classes=[{name,level:1,subclass:'',hitDiceRemaining:1}];state.hp.rawGains=[raw];state.saves=blankSaves();d.saves.forEach(a=>state.saves[a].proficient=true);if(num(d.subclass_level)===1){state.classes[0].subclass=prompt(`Choose your ${name} subclass. The included SRD option is ${d.included_srd_subclass}.`,d.included_srd_subclass)||'';}const features=featuresForLevel(name,1,state.classes[0].subclass);state.levelHistory=[{className:name,newClass:true,newClassLevel:1,rawHp:raw,features,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),starting:true}];state.hp.current=computedMaxHP();renderAll();scheduleSave();alert(`${name} level 1 initialized. Maximum HP and saving-throw proficiencies are now calculated.`);}
function prerequisitesMet(name){const reqs=DB.character_engine.multiclass_prerequisites[name]||[];let problems=[];reqs.forEach(r=>{if(Array.isArray(r[0])){if(!r[0].some(a=>finalScore(a)>=r[1]))problems.push(`${r[0].join(' or ')} ${r[1]}`);}else if(finalScore(r[0])<r[1])problems.push(`${r[0]} ${r[1]}`);});return problems;}
function startLevelUp(){if(!state.classes.length){alert('Initialize a starting class first.');return;}if(totalLevel()>=20){alert('Total character level is already 20.');return;}levelMode=confirm('Do you want this new level to start a NEW class (multiclass)?\n\nOK = Yes, choose a new class.\nCancel = No, advance an existing class.')?'new':'existing';const choices=levelMode==='new'?CLASS_NAMES.filter(n=>!state.classes.some(c=>c.name===n)):state.classes.map(c=>c.name);if(!choices.length){alert('No eligible class choices are available.');return;}$('levelClassChoice').innerHTML=choices.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('');$('levelDialogTitle').textContent=levelMode==='new'?'Multiclass Level Up':'Level Up Existing Class';$('levelDialogIntro').textContent=levelMode==='new'?'Choose the new class. The sheet checks the ability prerequisites for the current and new classes.':'Choose which existing class receives this level.';updateLevelValidation();$('levelDialog').showModal();}
function updateLevelValidation(){const name=$('levelClassChoice').value;if(!name)return;let text=`${name}: d${classData(name).hit_die} Hit Die. `;if(levelMode==='new'){let p=prerequisitesMet(name);state.classes.forEach(c=>p.push(...prerequisitesMet(c.name).map(x=>`${c.name} requires ${x}`)));text+=p.length?`Prerequisite warning: ${p.join('; ')}.`:'All tracked multiclass ability prerequisites are met.';}else text+=`New ${name} level: ${classLevel(name)+1}.`;$('levelValidation').textContent=text;$('levelHpManual').max=classData(name).hit_die;}
function applyASI(){const answer=prompt('This class level grants an Ability Score Improvement.\nEnter ONE ability name for +2, TWO comma-separated ability names for +1 each, or type FEAT to record a feat instead.','FEAT');if(!answer)return null;if(answer.trim().toUpperCase()==='FEAT'){const feat=prompt('Feat name:','');return feat?`Feat: ${feat}`:'Feat selected';}const names=answer.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(names.length===1&&ABILITIES.includes(names[0]))state.abilities[names[0]].other+=2;else if(names.length===2&&names.every(x=>ABILITIES.includes(x))){state.abilities[names[0]].other+=1;state.abilities[names[1]].other+=1;}else{alert('ASI entry was not recognized. You can edit the Other bonus boxes manually.');return'ASI pending';}return'ASI applied';}
function applyLevel(){const name=$('levelClassChoice').value,d=classData(name);if(levelMode==='new'){let problems=prerequisitesMet(name);state.classes.forEach(c=>problems.push(...prerequisitesMet(c.name).map(x=>`${c.name}: ${x}`)));if(problems.length&&!confirm('Multiclass prerequisites are not met:\n'+problems.join('\n')+'\n\nContinue with a DM override?'))return;}let raw=$('levelHpMode').value==='average'?Math.floor(d.hit_die/2)+1:clamp(num($('levelHpManual').value),1,d.hit_die);if(!raw){alert('Enter a valid raw Hit Die result.');return;}let c=state.classes.find(x=>x.name===name);if(!c){c={name,level:0,subclass:'',hitDiceRemaining:0};state.classes.push(c);}c.level++;c.hitDiceRemaining=num(c.hitDiceRemaining)+1;state.hp.rawGains.push(raw);if(c.level===num(d.subclass_level)&&!c.subclass)c.subclass=prompt(`Choose your ${name} subclass. Included SRD option: ${d.included_srd_subclass}`,d.included_srd_subclass)||'';const features=featuresForLevel(name,c.level,c.subclass);let choices=[];if(features.some(f=>/Ability Score Improvement/i.test(f)))choices.push(applyASI());if(features.some(f=>/Epic Boon/i.test(f))){const boon=prompt('This level grants an Epic Boon or another qualifying feat. Record the choice:','');if(boon)choices.push('Epic Boon / feat: '+boon);}state.levelHistory.push({className:name,newClass:levelMode==='new',newClassLevel:c.level,rawHp:raw,features,choices:choices.filter(Boolean),note:$('levelNote').value,timestamp:new Date().toISOString()});state.hp.current=Math.min(computedMaxHP(),state.hp.current+raw+abilityMod('Constitution')+(raceLevelHpBonus()?1:0));$('levelDialog').close();$('levelNote').value='';renderAll();scheduleSave();alert(`Level up complete! Total level ${totalLevel()}.\n${name} level ${c.level}.\nGained: ${features.length?features.join(', '):'spell/slot progression and Hit Die only'}.`);}
function undoLevel(){if(!state.levelHistory.length||totalLevel()<=1){alert('There is no later level to undo.');return;}const last=state.levelHistory[state.levelHistory.length-1];if(!confirm(`Undo the last level: ${last.className} ${last.newClassLevel}? Ability score choices are not automatically reversed; review Other bonuses afterward.`))return;const c=state.classes.find(x=>x.name===last.className);c.level--;c.hitDiceRemaining=Math.min(c.level,num(c.hitDiceRemaining));if(c.level<=0)state.classes=state.classes.filter(x=>x!==c);state.hp.rawGains.pop();state.levelHistory.pop();state.hp.current=Math.min(state.hp.current,computedMaxHP());renderAll();scheduleSave();}
function rest(kind){if(kind==='short'){autoResourceDefinitions().forEach(r=>{if(r.short==='all')state.resourceSpent[r.id]=0;else if(r.short==='one')state.resourceSpent[r.id]=Math.max(0,num(state.resourceSpent[r.id])-1);});state.pactSlotsSpent=0;state.customResources.forEach(r=>{if(r.reset==='short')r.current=r.max;});}else{state.resourceSpent={};state.spellSlotsSpent={};state.pactSlotsSpent=0;state.customResources.forEach(r=>{if(r.reset==='short'||r.reset==='long')r.current=r.max;});state.death={success:0,failure:0,stable:false};state.classes.forEach(c=>{const max=c.level;if(edition()==='5.5e')c.hitDiceRemaining=max;else c.hitDiceRemaining=Math.min(max,num(c.hitDiceRemaining)+Math.max(1,Math.floor(max/2)));});}renderAll();scheduleSave();setStatus(`${kind==='short'?'Short':'Long'} rest recovery applied.`,'ok');}
function castSpell(i){const r=state.spells[i],s=DB.spells.catalog[r.id]||r.custom||{},lvl=spellLevelNumber(s);if(lvl===0){alert(`${s.display_name||s.canonical_name||'Cantrip'} uses no spell slot.\n\n${howToRollSpell(s,r.className)}`);return;}if(lvl===null){alert('This imported spell has no identified level. Record the expenditure manually.');return;}if(/concentration/i.test(String(s.duration||'')+String(s.description||''))&&state.concentrating&&!confirm(`You are already concentrating on ${state.concentrationName||'another spell'}. Starting this spell ends the old concentration. Continue?`))return;let usePact=false;const p=pactInfo();if(r.className==='Warlock'&&p.slots-state.pactSlotsSpent>0)usePact=confirm(`Use a Pact Magic slot (level ${p.level})?\nCancel chooses a shared spell slot.`);if(usePact){state.pactSlotsSpent++;}else{let requested=prompt(`Spell level is ${lvl}. Enter the slot level to spend (${lvl}-9):`,String(lvl));if(requested===null)return;let slot=clamp(num(requested),lvl,9);if(sharedSlotMax(slot)-num(state.spellSlotsSpent[slot])<=0){alert(`No level ${slot} shared spell slot remains.`);return;}state.spellSlotsSpent[slot]=num(state.spellSlotsSpent[slot])+1;}if(/concentration/i.test(String(s.duration||'')+String(s.description||''))){state.concentrating=true;state.concentrationName=s.display_name||s.canonical_name||'';}renderAll();scheduleSave();alert(`${s.display_name||s.canonical_name} tracked as cast.\n\n${howToRollSpell(s,r.className)}`);}
function showSpell(i){const r=state.spells[i],s=DB.spells.catalog[r.id]||r.custom||{};$('spellDialogTitle').textContent=s.display_name||s.canonical_name||'Spell';$('spellDialogBody').textContent=`Level: ${s.level_label||'Unspecified'}\nSchool: ${s.school||'Unspecified'}\nClasses: ${(s.classes||[]).join(', ')}\nCasting Time: ${s.casting_time||''}\nRange: ${s.range||''}\nComponents: ${s.components||''}\nDuration: ${s.duration||''}\n\nHOW TO RESOLVE\n${howToRollSpell(s,r.className)}\n\nDESCRIPTION\n${s.description||'No description in imported data.'}`;$('spellDialog').showModal();}
function addSpell(){const s=findSpell($('spellSearch').value);if(!s){alert('No exact spell name match was found. Choose a suggestion from the list.');return;}const id=s.spell_id;state.spells.push({id,className:$('spellClassSelect').value,prepared:false,alwaysPrepared:false,notes:''});$('spellSearch').value='';renderSpells();scheduleSave();}
function referenceSearch(){const q=$('referenceSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();if(q.length<2){$('referenceResults').textContent='Enter at least two characters.';return;}let results=[];function walk(v,path,depth){if(results.length>=50||depth>8)return;if(typeof v==='string'||typeof v==='number'||typeof v==='boolean'){const text=String(v);if(text.toLowerCase().includes(q))results.push(`${path}: ${text.slice(0,500)}`);return;}if(Array.isArray(v)){v.forEach((x,i)=>walk(x,`${path}[${i}]`,depth+1));return;}if(v&&typeof v==='object')Object.entries(v).forEach(([k,x])=>{if(k.toLowerCase().includes(q))results.push(`${path}.${k}`);walk(x,`${path}.${k}`,depth+1);});}walk(DB,'DB',0);$('referenceResults').textContent=results.length?results.join('\n\n'):'No match found in the embedded reference.';}

}

}

function totalLevel(){try{return typeof window.totalLevel==='function'?window.totalLevel():stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}catch(_){return stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}}
function swadeRank(n){return n>=16?'Legendary':n>=12?'Heroic':n>=8?'Veteran':n>=4?'Seasoned':'Novice'}
function fateResources(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Resources')?.rating)}
function cocCredit(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Credit Rating')?.value)}
function cocBand(v){return v<=0?'Penniless':v<=9?'Poor':v<=49?'Average':v<=89?'Wealthy':v<=98?'Rich':'Super rich'}
function bitdTrackInfo(){const s=stateRef(),t=$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'playbook',threshold=t==='playbook'?8:t==='crew'?10:6,current=t==='crew'?number(s.crew?.crewXp):number(s.xp?.[t]);return{t,threshold,current}}
function progressionInfo(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();switch(CFG.progression){case'dnd-xp':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?null:DND_XP[l];return{current:xp,next:next===null?'Maximum level':Math.max(0,next-xp)+' XP',status:next!==null&&xp>=next?'Level ready':'Level '+l,prompt:next===null?'Level 20 reached.':`Standard threshold for level ${l+1}: ${next.toLocaleString()} cumulative XP.`}}case'pf2e-xp':{const xp=number(a.progression.xp);return{current:xp+' XP',next:Math.max(0,1000-xp)+' XP',status:xp>=1000?'Level ready':'Level '+number(s.profile?.level),prompt:'Pathfinder uses 1,000 XP per level; excess XP carries over.'}}case'pbta-xp':{const cur=number(s.xp?.current),max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max)||5);return{current:`${cur}/${max}`,next:Math.max(0,max-cur)+' marks',status:cur>=max?'Advance ready':'Tracking',prompt:'The exact playbook defines what an advance can buy. The sheet never invents a universal PbtA level system.'}}case'swade-advances':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n),next=n<4?4:n<8?8:n<12?12:n<16?16:null;return{current:n+' Advances',next:next?`${next-n} to ${swadeRank(next)}`:'Legendary',status:rank,prompt:'Each recorded Advance automatically recalculates Rank and opens the improvement checklist.'}}case'bitd-xp':{const x=bitdTrackInfo();return{current:`${x.current}/${x.threshold}`,next:Math.max(0,x.threshold-x.current)+' XP',status:x.current>=x.threshold?'Advance ready':x.t,prompt:'Playbook fills at 8; Insight, Prowess, and Resolve at 6; crew XP fills at 10.'}}case'narrative-levels':{const lvl=number(s.profile?.level)||1,ss=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel),target=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel)||3);return{current:`Level ${lvl}`,next:lvl>=10?'Maximum level':`${Math.max(0,target-ss)} session(s)`,status:ss>=target&&lvl<10?'Milestone suggested':`Tier ${lvl===1?1:lvl<=4?2:lvl<=7?3:4}`,prompt:'The party levels together when the Guide declares a narrative milestone, commonly around every three sessions.'}}case'character-points':{const earned=number(a.progression.earned),spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),budget=number(s.budget);const available=budget+earned-spent;return{current:`${available} available`,next:`${earned} earned`,status:available<0?'Overspent':'Balanced',prompt:`Starting budget ${budget}; earned ${earned}; calculated spent ${spent}; available ${available}.`}}case'development':{const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos');return{current:checked.length+' checked',next:checked.length?'Development phase':'Use skills',status:cocBand(cocCredit()),prompt:`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()} is ${cocBand(cocCredit())}. Checked skills are resolved with externally supplied d100 and d10 results.`}}case'milestones':{const m=a.progression.milestones,total=number(m.minor)+number(m.significant)+number(m.major);return{current:total+' awarded',next:'Story-driven',status:`Resources ${fateResources()}`,prompt:'Minor, significant, and major milestones change the character according to the fiction; Fate Core does not use XP levels.'}}default:return{current:'—',next:'—',status:'Ready',prompt:''}}
}

workflow.</p><ul><li>Choose the class receiving the level.</li><li>Apply Hit Die / HP growth, proficiency changes, class features, subclass features, spell slots, prepared/known limits, and tracked features.</li></ul>`;case'pf2e-xp':return `<p>Advance from level ${number(s.profile?.level)} to ${Math.min(20,number(s.profile?.level)+1)} and carry excess XP.</p><ul><li>Increase level-based proficiency automatically through the sheet.</li><li>Recalculate HP, AC, saves, Perception, skills, class DC, spell DC, and strike modifiers.</li><li>Review the level’s class/skill/general/ancestry feat and ability-boost schedule.</li><li>Update spell ranks, slots, equipment expectations, and retraining choices.</li></ul>`;case'pbta-xp':return `<p>The XP track is full.</p><ul><li>Choose an improvement from the exact game and playbook.</li><li>Record any stat increase, new move, cross-playbook move, relationship change, retirement, or playbook change.</li><li>The sheet subtracts one full XP track and preserves carryover.</li></ul>`;case'swade-advances':return `<p>Record one SWADE Advance.</p><ul><li>Gain an eligible Edge; or increase one skill at/above its linked Attribute one die type.</li><li>Increase two skills below linked Attributes; or buy a new skill at d4.</li><li>Increase one Attribute when allowed for the current Rank.</li><li>Check Rank, Trait, setting, ancestry, and Arcane Background prerequisites.</li></ul>`;case'bitd-xp':{const x=bitdTrackInfo();return `<p>${html(x.t)} XP is full.</p><ul><li>${x.t==='playbook'?'Choose a new special ability.':x.t==='crew'?'Choose one crew special ability or mark two crew upgrade boxes.':'Add one action dot under '+html(x.t)+'.'}</li><li>Subtract one full track and preserve overflow.</li><li>Record the choice in the appropriate ability, action, or crew area.</li></ul>`}case'narrative-levels':{const n=Math.min(10,number(s.profile?.level)+1);return `<p>Advance the party to Daggerheart level ${n}.</p><ul><li>Choose two valid advancement slots.</li><li>Increase Major and Severe damage thresholds by 1.</li><li>Gain one legal domain card at or below the new level.</li>${[2,5,8].includes(n)?'<li>Tier achievement: gain a +2 Experience and increase Proficiency by 1.</li>':''}<li>Recalculate Evasion, HP, Stress, Proficiency, thresholds, and card loadout.</li></ul>`}case'character-points':return `<p>Spend earned character points only when training, story, and campaign permissions support the change.</p><ul><li>Improve or learn skills.</li><li>Raise attributes or secondary characteristics with approval.</li><li>Buy new advantages or buy off disadvantages when justified.</li><li>The point ledger automatically recalculates spent and available points.</li></ul>`;case'development':return `<p>Resolve checked skills using d100 results supplied by the table or future portal.</p><ul><li>If the d100 result is above the current skill, add the supplied d10 improvement.</li><li>If the result is equal to or below the skill, no increase occurs.</li><li>Erase the check after resolving it.</li><li>Cthulhu Mythos does not use ordinary improvement checks.</li></ul><div class="hyper-manual-roll"><label>Improvement check d100 result <input id="cocImproveRoll" type="number" min="1" max="100" value="50"></label><label>Improvement d10 result <input id="cocImproveGain" type="number" min="1" max="10" value="5"></label></div>`;case'milestones':{const t=$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'minor';const rows={minor:['Switch two skill ratings.','Replace one Average skill.','Replace a stunt.','Rename a non-high-concept aspect.','Clear stress and begin consequence recovery as fiction allows.'],significant:['Gain one skill point while preserving a valid skill column.','Also receive the benefits of a minor milestone.'],major:['Gain one Refresh.','Advance a skill beyond the current cap if the campaign allows.','Rename the high concept if the story supports it.','Recover the ability to take an extreme consequence after rewriting it.','Also receive significant and minor milestone benefits.']}[t];return `<p>Apply a ${html(t)} milestone.</p><ul>${rows.map(x=>'<li>'+html(x)+'</li>').join('')}</ul>`}default:return'<p>Record the advancement in the system-specific sections.</p>'}}
function recordProgress(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperProgressAmount')?.value||1)),memo=$('hyperProgressMemo')?.value||'';if(CFG.progression==='development'){openModal('Call of Cthulhu Development Phase',advancementChecklist(),'coc-development-'+(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked).map(x=>x.name).join('|'),true);return}if(CFG.progression==='milestones'){const t=$('hyperProgressTarget').value;a.progression.milestones[t]=number(a.progression.milestones[t])+Math.max(1,amount);history('progression',Math.max(1,amount),memo,{target:t});if(s.advancement)s.advancement.milestone=t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1);openModal(`${t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1)} Milestone`,advancementChecklist(),`fate-${t}-${a.progression.milestones[t]}`,true)}else if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){s.profile.xp=number(s.profile.xp)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'){a.progression.xp=number(a.progression.xp)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'){s.xp.current=number(s.xp.current)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='swade-advances'){const count=Math.max(1,Math.floor(amount));a.progression.advances=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0)+count;for(let i=0;i<count;i++)s.advances.push({name:`Advance ${s.advances.length+1}`,rank:swadeRank(a.progression.advances),type:'',notes:memo});s.profile.rank=swadeRank(a.progression.advances);history('progression',count,memo,{target:'advance'});openModal('SWADE Advance Recorded',advancementChecklist(),`swade-${a.progression.advances}`,true)}else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.t==='crew')s.crew.crewXp=number(s.crew.crewXp)+amount;else s.xp[x.t]=number(s.xp[x.t])+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:x.t})}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'sessions'})}else if(CFG.progression==='character-points'){a.progression.earned=number(a.progression.earned)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'character-points'})}rerender();checkProgression(true)}
function applyProgression(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef();if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){$('levelUpBtn')?.click();closeModal();return}if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'){if(number(a.progression.xp)<1000||number(s.profile.level)>=20)return;const old=number(s.profile.level);a.progression.xp-=1000;s.profile.level=old+1;history('progression',1,`Advanced to level ${s.profile.level}`,{target:'level'});if(s.hp){const gain=number(s.hp.classPerLevel)+number(s.attributes?.con);s.hp.current=number(s.hp.current)+Math.max(1,gain)}a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'){const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)||5);if(number(s.xp.current)<max)return;s.xp.current-=max;s.advancements=s.advancements||[];s.advancements.push({name:'Choose exact-game advancement',notes:'XP track completed '+new Date().toLocaleDateString()});history('progression',1,'XP track converted to an advancement',{target:'advance'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current<x.threshold)return;if(x.t==='crew')s.crew.crewXp-=x.threshold;else s.xp[x.t]-=x.threshold;history('progression',1,`${x.t} track converted to an advance`,{target:x.t});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){const lvl=number(s.profile.level);if(lvl>=10)return;const next=lvl+1;s.profile.level=next;s.thresholds.majorMod=number(s.thresholds.majorMod)+1;s.thresholds.severeMod=number(s.thresholds.severeMod)+1;if([2,5,8].includes(next)){s.resources.proficiency=number(s.resources.proficiency)+1;s.experiences=s.experiences||[];s.experiences.push({name:'New Tier Experience',value:2})}a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=0;history('progression',1,`Advanced to Daggerheart level ${next}`,{target:'level'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='development'){const skillName=$('cocDevelopmentSkill')?.value,skill=(s.skills||[]).find(x=>x.name===skillName);if(!skill)return;const roll=clamp(number($('cocImproveRoll')?.value),1,100),gain=clamp(number($('cocImproveGain')?.value),1,10),old=number(skill.value),success=roll>old;if(success)skill.value=clamp(old+gain,0,99);skill.checked=false;history('progression',success?gain:0,`${skill.name}: d100 ${roll} vs ${old}${success?`, +${gain}`:', no increase'}`,{target:skill.name,roll,gain,success});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='milestones'){history('progression',0,'Milestone checklist acknowledged',{target:$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'minor'})}else if(CFG.progression==='character-points'){history('progression',0,'Character point spending checklist reviewed',{target:'character-points'})}closeModal();rerender();checkProgression(false)}
function checkProgression(force=false){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();if(!$('hyperProgressModal'))return;if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];if(number(s.profile?.xp)>=next)openModal(`Level ${l+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`dnd-${l+1}-${number(s.profile.xp)}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'&&number(a.progression.xp)>=1000&&number(s.profile.level)<20)openModal(`Pathfinder Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`pf-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${Math.floor(number(a.progression.xp)/1000)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'&&number(s.xp.current)>=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)))openModal('PbtA Advancement Ready',advancementChecklist(),`pbta-${number(s.xp.current)}-${number(s.xp.max)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current>=x.threshold)openModal(`${x.t[0].toUpperCase()+x.t.slice(1)} Advance Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`bitd-${x.t}-${x.current}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'&&number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)>=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel))&&number(s.profile.level)<10)openModal(`Daggerheart Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Suggested`,advancementChecklist(),`dh-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='development'&&(s.skills||[]).some(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos')&&force)openModal('Development Phase Ready',advancementChecklist(),`coc-${(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked).length}`,force)}
function wallet(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),w=a.currency.wallet;if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return s.coins||(s.coins={cp:0,sp:0,ep:0,gp:0,pp:0});if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return{get coin(){return number(s.resources.coin)},set coin(v){s.resources.coin=v},get stash(){return number(s.resources.stash)},set stash(v){s.resources.stash=v},get crewCoin(){return number(s.crew.coin)},set crewCoin(v){s.crew.coin=v}};return w}
function ratios(){switch(CFG.currency){case'dnd-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,ep:50,gp:100,pp:1000};case'pf2e-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,gp:100,pp:1000};case'daggerheart-gold':return{coin:1,handful:10,bag:100,chest:1000};default:return null}}
function currencyUnit(){return $('hyperCurrencyUnit')?.value||auto().currency.unit||({'dnd-coins':'cp','pf2e-coins':'cp','daggerheart-gold':'coin','bitd-coin':'coin','coc-finance':'cash','fate-abstract':'story funds'})[CFG.currency]||'unit'}
function currencyTotal(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(r){const total=Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0);if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;if(CFG.currency==='pf2e-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;return`${total.toLocaleString()} coins · ${(total/10).toFixed(1)} handfuls · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} bags · ${(total/1000).toFixed(3)} chests`}if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return`${number(w.coin)} carried coin · ${number(w.stash)} stash · ${number(w.crewCoin)} crew coin`;if(CFG.currency==='coc-finance')return`Cash ${number(w.cash).toLocaleString()} · Assets ${number(w.assets).toLocaleString()} · Spending ${number(w.spending).toLocaleString()} · Credit ${cocCredit()} (${cocBand(cocCredit())})`;if(CFG.currency==='fate-abstract')return`Resources ${fateResources()} · ${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()} (optional exact funds)`;return`${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()}`}
function syncCurrencyInputs(){const w=wallet();qa('[data-currency-key]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.currencyKey;el.value=number(w[k])});if($('hyperCurrencyUnit'))$('hyperCurrencyUnit').value=auto().currency.unit}
function currencyTransaction(sign){const w=wallet(),key=$('hyperCurrencyDenom').value,amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperCurrencyAmount').value)),delta=sign*amount,memo=$('hyperCurrencyMemo').value;if(sign<0&&number(w[key])<amount){openModal('Insufficient Currency',`<p>The ${html(key)} balance is ${number(w[key])}; this transaction needs ${amount}.</p>`,'',true);return}w[key]=number(w[key])+delta;history('currency',delta,memo,{denomination:key});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}
function normalizeCurrency(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(!r){if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin'){openModal('Blades Coin & Stash',`<ul><li>Deposit: 1 coin becomes 1 stash.</li><li>Withdrawal: spend 2 stash to gain 1 coin.</li><li>Carried coin above 4 normally consumes load or must be stored.</li></ul>`,'',true)}return}let total=Math.round(Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0));Object.entries(r).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).forEach(([k,m])=>{w[k]=Math.floor(total/m);total%=m});history('currency',0,'Normalized denominations',{denomination:'all'});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}
function renderCurrency(){if(!$('hyperCurrencyTotal'))return;syncCurrencyInputs();$('hyperCurrencyTotal').textContent=currencyTotal()}
function renderLedgers(){const a=auto(),render=(id,rows)=>{const el=$(id);if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=rows.length?rows.slice(0,80).map(e=>`<div class="hyper-ledger-entry"><span>${new Date(e.at).toLocaleString()}</span><span>${html(e.memo||e.target||e.type)}</span><b>${number(e.amount)>=0?'+':''}${number(e.amount)}${e.denomination?' '+html(e.denomination):''}</b></div>`).join(''):'<div class="hyper-note">No entries yet.</div>'};render('hyperCurrencyLedger',a.currency.history);render('hyperProgressLedger',a.progression.history)}
function runAudit(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto(),items=[];const good=t=>items.push({kind:'good',text:t}),warn=t=>items.push({kind:'warn',text:t});switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const refresh=number(s.computed?.outputs?.fateRefresh),fp=number(s.fatePoints);refresh<1?warn('Refresh is below the normal minimum of 1.'):good(`Refresh ${refresh}; Fate points ${fp}.`);s.computed?.pyramidValid?good('Skill pyramid/column validation passes.'):warn('Skill pyramid/column validation needs attention.');break}case'gurps-4e':{const spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),available=number(s.budget)+number(a.progression.earned)-spent;available<0?warn(`Point budget overspent by ${Math.abs(available)}.`):good(`${available} character points available.`);number(s.combat?.hpCurrent)<=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsHP)/3&&warn('Current HP is at or below one-third; apply injury and movement rules.');break}case'coc-7e':{good(`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()}: ${cocBand(cocCredit())}.`);const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos').length;checked?warn(`${checked} skill improvement check(s) are ready.`):good('No unresolved skill improvement checks.');number(s.resources?.sanCurrent)<number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)-Math.floor(number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)/5)&&warn('Session SAN loss may have reached the indefinite-insanity threshold.');break}case'daggerheart':{const r=s.resources||{};number(r.hope)>number(r.hopeMax)?warn('Hope exceeds maximum.'):good(`Hope ${number(r.hope)}/${number(r.hopeMax)}.`);number(r.hpMarked)>number(r.hpMax)&&warn('Marked HP exceeds available HP slots.');number(r.stressMarked)>number(r.stressMax)&&warn('Marked Stress exceeds available Stress slots.');number(wallet().chest)>1&&warn('More than one chest is marked as carried.');break}case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':{number(a.progression.xp)>=1000?warn('At least one level is ready to apply.'):good(`${number(a.progression.xp)} / 1000 XP.`);number(s.dying)>=4?warn('Dying value is at the normal death threshold.'):good(`Dying ${number(s.dying)}, Wounded ${number(s.wounded)}, Doomed ${number(s.doomed)}.`);break}case'pbta-adapter':{const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max));number(s.xp?.current)>=max?warn('XP track is full.'):good(`XP ${number(s.xp?.current)}/${max}.`);number(s.harm?.current)>=number(s.harm?.max)&&warn('Harm/condition track is full.');break}case'swade':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n);s.profile.rank!==rank?warn(`Rank should be ${rank} from ${n} Advances.`):good(`${n} Advances: ${rank}.`);number(s.resources?.wounds)>=3&&warn('Three Wounds marked; check Incapacitation procedure.');break}case'blades-in-the-dark':{number(s.resources?.coin)>4?warn('More than 4 coin carried; excess normally costs load or needs storage.'):good(`${number(s.resources?.coin)} carried coin.`);number(s.resources?.stress)>=number(s.resources?.stressMax)&&warn('Stress track is full; resolve trauma.');['playbook','insight','prowess','resolve'].forEach(k=>{const max=k==='playbook'?8:6;if(number(s.xp?.[k])>=max)warn(`${k} XP track is full.`)});number(s.crew?.crewXp)>=10&&warn('Crew XP track is full.');break}case'dnd-5e-5.5e':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];xp>=next&&warn(`Enough XP for level ${l+1}.`);good(`Level ${l}; proficiency bonus ${2+Math.floor(Math.max(0,l-1)/4)}.`);const coins=s.coins||{},cp=number(coins.cp)+10*number(coins.sp)+50*number(coins.ep)+100*number(coins.gp)+1000*number(coins.pp);good(`${(cp/100).toFixed(2)} gp equivalent.`);break}}
 a.audit.lastRun=now();const ul=$('hyperMathAudit');if(ul)ul.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`<li class="${x.kind}">${html(x.text)}</li>`).join('');return items}
function renderProgress(){if(!$('hyperProgressCurrent'))return;const i=progressionInfo();$('hyperProgressCurrent').textContent=i.current;$('hyperProgressNext').textContent=i.next;$('hyperProgressStatus').textContent=i.status;$('hyperProgressPrompt').textContent=i.prompt;if(CFG.progression==='development'){const sel=$('cocDevelopmentSkill'),current=sel?.value;sel.innerHTML=(stateRef().skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos').map(x=>`<option value="${html(x.name)}">${html(x.name)} (${number(x.value)}%)</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">No checked skills</option>';if(current&&qa('option',sel).some(o=>o.value===current))sel.value=current}if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){$('hyperProgressAmount').value=Math.max(1,number($('hyperProgressAmount').value)||1)}runAudit()}

function currentRollContract(){const s=stateRef();switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const skill=s.skills?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.skill);return{kind:'fate_action',dice:'4dF',skill:s.roll?.skill,skill_rating:number(skill?.rating),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),invokes:number(s.roll?.invokeCount),opposition:number(s.roll?.opposition),action:s.roll?.action}}case'gurps-4e':return{kind:'gurps_success_roll',dice:'3d6',target:number(s.combat?.attackSkill)+number(s.combat?.attackModifier),roll_under:true};case'coc-7e':return{kind:'coc_percentile',dice:'d100',skill:s.roll?.skill,target:number(s.roll?.target),difficulty:s.roll?.difficulty,bonus_penalty:number(s.roll?.bonusPenalty)};case'daggerheart':return{kind:'daggerheart_action',dice:'2d12_hope_fear',trait:s.roll?.trait,trait_modifier:number(s.traits?.[s.roll?.trait]),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),advantage:number(s.roll?.advantage),difficulty:number(s.roll?.difficulty),experience_index:number(s.roll?.experienceIndex)};case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':return{kind:'pf2e_check',dice:'d20',type:s.roll?.type,key:s.roll?.key,dc:number(s.roll?.dc),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),map:number(s.roll?.map),agile:!!s.roll?.agile};case'pbta-adapter':{const move=s.moves?.[number(s.roll?.moveIndex)-1];const stat=s.stats?.find(x=>x.name===move?.stat);return{kind:'pbta_move',dice:s.adapter?.resolution,move:move?.name,stat:move?.stat,stat_value:number(stat?.value),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier)+number(s.roll?.forward)+number(s.roll?.ongoing),bands:copy(s.adapter)}}case'swade':return{kind:'swade_trait',dice:`d${s.roll?.traitType==='attribute'?number(s.attributes?.[s.roll?.trait]):number(s.skills?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.trait)?.die)}${s.roll?.wildCard?'+wild d6':''}`,trait:s.roll?.trait,modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier)-(s.roll?.woundPenalty?number(s.resources?.wounds):0),target:number(s.roll?.target),acing:true};case'blades-in-the-dark':{const action=s.actions?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.action),pool=number(action?.rating)+number(s.roll?.bonus)+(s.roll?.push?1:0)+(s.roll?.assist?1:0)+(s.roll?.devilsBargain?1:0);return{kind:'bitd_action',dice_pool:pool,zero_dice:pool<=0,action:s.roll?.action,position:s.roll?.position,effect:s.roll?.effect}}case'dnd-5e-5.5e':return{kind:'dnd_d20_test',dice:'d20',level:totalLevel(),proficiency_bonus:2+Math.floor(Math.max(0,totalLevel()-1)/4),note:'Request a specific skill, save, initiative, attack, or spell action from the exported character state.'};default:return{kind:'custom'}}}
function resolveExternalRoll(payload={}){const c=currentRollContract(),s=stateRef();let out={system:CFG.id,kind:c.kind,received:copy(payload),at:now()};if(c.kind==='fate_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.reduce((n,x)=>n+number(x),0):number(payload.diceTotal);const total=dice+c.skill_rating+c.modifier+c.invokes*2,shifts=total-c.opposition;out={...out,total,shifts,outcome:shifts<0?'Fail':shifts===0?'Tie':shifts<3?'Succeed':'Succeed with style'}}else if(c.kind==='gurps_success_roll'){const roll=number(payload.total),margin=c.target-roll;out={...out,total:roll,target:c.target,margin,outcome:roll<=c.target?'Success':'Failure'}}else if(c.kind==='coc_percentile'){const roll=number(payload.total),target=c.target,hard=Math.floor(target/2),extreme=Math.floor(target/5);let level=roll===1?'Critical':roll<=extreme?'Extreme':roll<=hard?'Hard':roll<=target?'Regular':roll>=96?'Fumble':'Failure';const needed=c.difficulty==='Extreme'?'Extreme':c.difficulty==='Hard'?'Hard':'Regular',rank={Failure:0,Fumble:0,Regular:1,Hard:2,Extreme:3,Critical:4};out={...out,total:roll,target,success:rank[level]>=rank[needed],level,needed}}else if(c.kind==='daggerheart_action'){const hope=number(payload.hope),fear=number(payload.fear),exp=c.experience_index>=0?number(s.experiences?.[c.experience_index]?.value):0,total=hope+fear+c.trait_modifier+c.modifier+exp+number(payload.advantageTotal),critical=hope===fear,duality=hope>=fear?'Hope':'Fear';out={...out,hope,fear,total,critical,duality,success:critical||total>=c.difficulty}}else if(c.kind==='pf2e_check'){const die=number(payload.die),baseMod=number(payload.totalModifier??c.modifier),total=die+baseMod,delta=total-c.dc;let degree=delta>=10?3:delta>=0?2:delta<=-10?0:1;if(die===20)degree=Math.min(3,degree+1);if(die===1)degree=Math.max(0,degree-1);out={...out,die,total,dc:c.dc,degree:['Critical Failure','Failure','Success','Critical Success'][degree]}}else if(c.kind==='pbta_move'){const dice=number(payload.total),total=dice+c.modifier,a=c.bands;let band=total>=number(a.advancedMin)?a.advancedLabel:total>=number(a.highMin)?a.hitLabel:total<=number(a.lowMax)?a.missLabel:a.mixedLabel;out={...out,dice,total,band}}else if(c.kind==='swade_trait'){const trait=number(payload.traitTotal),wild=payload.wildTotal===undefined?null:number(payload.wildTotal),best=wild===null?trait:Math.max(trait,wild),total=best+c.modifier,raises=total>=c.target?Math.floor((total-c.target)/4):0;out={...out,trait,wild,total,target:c.target,success:total>=c.target,raises}}else if(c.kind==='bitd_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.map(number):[],sorted=[...dice].sort((a,b)=>b-a),highest=sorted[0]||0,critical=sorted.filter(x=>x===6).length>=2&&!c.zero_dice;out={...out,dice,highest,critical,outcome:critical?'Critical':highest===6?'Full success':highest>=4?'Partial success':'Bad outcome'}}else if(c.kind==='dnd_d20_test'){const die=number(payload.die),modifier=number(payload.modifier),total=die+modifier;out={...out,die,modifier,total,dc:payload.dc===undefined?null:number(payload.dc),success:payload.dc===undefined?null:total>=number(payload.dc)}}auto().portal.lastResult=out;auto().portal.lastRequest=c;schedule();renderPortal();window.parent!==window&&window.parent.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_ROLL_RESOLVED',payload:out},'*');return out}

(()=>{
'use strict';
function initTrueMenu(){
  const bubble=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubble');
  const toggle=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubbleToggle');
  const panel=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubblePanel');
  if(!bubble||!toggle||!panel||bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady==='1')return;
  bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady='1';
  toggle.title='Open navigation and sheet design menu. Drag the button to move it.';
  panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  panel.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');

  const backdrop=document.createElement('button');
  backdrop.type='button';
  backdrop.className='cs-menu-backdrop';
  backdrop.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  bubble.insertBefore(backdrop,panel);

  const title=panel.querySelector('.cs-panel-title');
  const header=document.createElement('div');
  header.className='cs-menu-header';
  const close=document.createElement('button');
  close.type='button';
  close.className='cs-menu-close';
  close.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  close.textContent='×';
  panel.insertBefore(header,panel.firstChild);
  if(title)header.appendChild(title);
  header.appendChild(close);

  const navGroup=document.createElement('div');
  navGroup.className='cs-menu-nav';
  navGroup.innerHTML='<span class="cs-label">Quick navigation</span><div class="cs-menu-link-grid"></div>';
  header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',navGroup);
  const grid=navGroup.querySelector('.cs-menu-link-grid');
  const navLinks=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav.nav a[href^="#"]')];
  const targets=[{label:'Top of Sheet',target:'__top'},...navLinks.map(a=>({label:(a.textContent||'Section').trim(),target:a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)})),{label:'Bottom of Sheet',target:'__bottom'}];
  const seen=new Set();
  targets.forEach(item=>{
    const key=item.target+'|'+item.label;
    if(seen.has(key))return;
    seen.add(key);
    const button=document.createElement('button');
    button.type='button';
    button.className='cs-menu-link';
    button.textContent=item.label;
    button.dataset.jumpTarget=item.target;
    grid.appendChild(button);
  });

  function closeMenu(returnFocus=false){
    bubble.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    if(returnFocus)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  close.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  backdrop.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  grid.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    const button=event.target.closest('.cs-menu-link');
    if(!button)return;
    const target=button.dataset.jumpTarget;
    if(target==='__top')window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    else if(target==='__bottom')window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});
    else document.getElementById(target)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
    closeMenu(false);
  });

  let wasOpen=false;
  function syncOpenState(){
    const open=bubble.classList.contains('open');
    document.body.classList.toggle('cs-menu-open',open);
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!open));
    if(open!==wasOpen){
      if(open)requestAnimationFrame(()=>close.focus({preventScroll:true}));
      else if(panel.contains(document.activeElement))toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
      wasOpen=open;
    }
  }
  new MutationObserver(syncOpenState).observe(bubble,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  syncOpenState();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initTrueMenu,{once:true});else initTrueMenu();
})();
</script>

const STORE='ttrpg-rules-homebrew-engine:'+SYSTEM_ID+':v2';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id); const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const uid=()=>Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Date.now().toString(36);
let state={version:2,system:SYSTEM_ID,selected:[],bases:[{id:uid(),key:'level',label:'Level / Rank / Tier',value:1}],formulas:[],links:[]};
function cleanKey(s){return String(s||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').replace(/^_|_$/g,'')}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(state));status('Saved locally.','good')}catch(e){status('Could not save: '+e.message,'danger')}}
function load(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(STORE);if(raw){const x=JSON.parse(raw);if(x&&x.system===SYSTEM_ID)state=Object.assign(state,x)}}catch(e){status('Autosave could not be loaded.','danger')}}
function status(msg,type=''){const n=$('rheStatus');if(!n)return;n.textContent=msg;n.className='rhe-status '+(type==='good'?'rhe-good':type==='danger'?'rhe-danger':'');}
function download(name,obj){const b=new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(b),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),1000)}
function detectFields(){const out=[];document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach((el,i)=>{if(el.closest('#rules-homebrew-engine')||['button','file','hidden','checkbox','radio'].includes(el.type))return;let label='';if(el.id){const l=document.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(el.id)}"]`);if(l)label=l.textContent.trim()}if(!label){const l=el.closest('label');if(l)label=l.textContent.replace(el.value||'','').trim()}if(!label)label=el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.placeholder||el.name||el.id||`Field ${i+1}`;out.push({token:el.id?'#'+el.id:'@'+i,label:label.slice(0,90),el})});return out}
function tokenize(expr){const s=String(expr||'').trim();if(!s)return[];const re=/\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d*\.\d+|\d+|[()+\-*/%,])\s*/gy;let m,pos=0,t=[];while((m=re.exec(s))){if(m.index!==pos)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));t.push(m[1]);pos=re.lastIndex}if(pos!==s.length)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));return t}
function evalExpr(expr,ctx){const t=tokenize(expr);let p=0;const peek=()=>t[p],take=()=>t[p++];function primary(){let x=take();if(x===undefined)throw Error('Incomplete formula');if(x==='('){let v=add();if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing )');return v}if(x==='+'||x==='-'){let v=primary();return x==='-'?-v:v}if(/^\d/.test(x))return Number(x);if(/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(x)){if(peek()==='('){take();let a=[];if(peek()!==')'){while(true){a.push(add());if(peek()===','){take();continue}break}}if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing ) after function');const f={min:Math.min,max:Math.max,floor:Math.floor,ceil:Math.ceil,round:Math.round,abs:Math.abs}[x.toLowerCase()];if(!f)throw Error('Unknown function '+x);return f(...a)}return Number(ctx[cleanKey(x)]??0)}throw Error('Unexpected '+x)}function mul(){let v=primary();while(['*','/','%'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=primary();v=o==='*'?v*r:o==='/'?(r===0?0:v/r):v%r}return v}function add(){let v=mul();while(['+','-'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=mul();v=o==='+'?v+r:v-r}return v}const v=add();if(p<t.length)throw Error('Unexpected '+peek());return Number.isFinite(v)?v:0}
function calculate(){const ctx={},detail={};state.bases.forEach(b=>{const k=cleanKey(b.key||b.label);if(!k)return;const v=Number(b.value)||0;ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:b.label||k,base:v,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:v}});const active=state.selected.filter(o=>o.active!==false);for(const o of active){for(const ef of o.effects||[]){const k=cleanKey(ef.target);if(!k)continue;if(!detail[k])detail[k]={label:ef.target||k,base:Number(ctx[k])||0,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:Number(ctx[k])||0};let v=0;try{v=evalExpr(ef.value,ctx)}catch(err){v=0;ef.error=err.message}const note={value:v,from:o.name,formula:ef.value};({add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]&&detail[k][{add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]].push(note))}}
for(const [k,d] of Object.entries(detail)){let v=d.base;d.adds.forEach(x=>v+=x.value);d.mults.forEach(x=>v*=x.value);d.sets.forEach(x=>v=x.value);d.mins.forEach(x=>v=Math.max(v,x.value));d.maxs.forEach(x=>v=Math.min(v,x.value));d.final=Number.isFinite(v)?v:0;ctx[k]=d.final}
// derived formulas: multiple passes for dependencies
for(let pass=0;pass<Math.max(2,state.formulas.length+1);pass++)for(const f of state.formulas){const k=cleanKey(f.key||f.label);if(!k)continue;try{const v=evalExpr(f.formula,ctx);ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:f.label||k,base:null,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],formula:f.formula,final:v}}catch(err){detail[k]={label:f.label||k,formula:f.formula,error:err.message,final:0};ctx[k]=0}}
return{ctx,detail}}
function renderCatalog(){const q=$('rheSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase(),cat=$('rheCategory').value,kind=$('rheKind').value;let a=CATALOG.filter(x=>(!cat||x.category===cat)&&(!kind||x.kind===kind)&&(!q||[x.name,x.category,x.source,x.summary,(x.tags||[]).join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)));const cap=$('rheShowAll').dataset.all==='1'?a.length:250;a=a.slice(0,cap);$('rheCatalog').innerHTML=a.length?a.map(x=>`<div class="rhe-row"><div><b>${esc(x.name)}</b><small>${esc(x.summary||'')}</small></div><div><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(x.category)}</span><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(x.kind)}</span></div><div><small>${esc(x.source||'')}</small>${x.url?`<a class="rhe-source-link" href="${esc(x.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Official/live source</a>`:''}</div><button type="button" data-rhe-add="${esc(x.id)}">Add</button></div>`).join(''):`<div class="rhe-empty">No matching catalog entries.</div>`;}
function renderSelected(){const root=$('rheSelected');if(!state.selected.length){root.innerHTML='<div class="rhe-empty">No options added yet.</div>';return}root.innerHTML=state.selected.map((o,i)=>`<div class="rhe-card"><div class="rhe-card-head"><div><h4>${esc(o.name)}</h4><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(o.category)}</span><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(o.approval||o.kind||'Pending')}</span><small>${esc(o.source||'')}</small></div><div><label><input type="checkbox" data-rhe-active="${i}" ${o.active!==false?'checked':''}> Active</label> <button type="button" data-rhe-effect-add="${i}">Add Effect</button> <button type="button" data-rhe-remove="${i}">Remove</button></div></div><div class="rhe-approval"><label>Level / Rank / Tier<input data-rhe-opt="level" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(o.level||'')}"></label><label>Approval<select data-rhe-opt="approval" data-i="${i}">${['Pending DM/GM/MOL review','Approved by DM','Approved by GM','Approved by MOL','Official/open option'].map(v=>`<option ${v===(o.approval||'')?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div><label>Notes / prerequisites<textarea data-rhe-opt="notes" data-i="${i}">${esc(o.notes||o.summary||'')}</textarea></label><div>${(o.effects||[]).map((ef,j)=>`<div class="rhe-effect-grid"><label>Target key<input data-rhe-ef="target" data-i="${i}" data-j="${j}" value="${esc(ef.target||'')}"></label><label>Operation<select data-rhe-ef="op" data-i="${i}" data-j="${j}">${['add','multiply','set','min','max'].map(v=>`<option ${v===ef.op?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Value / formula<input data-rhe-ef="value" data-i="${i}" data-j="${j}" value="${esc(ef.value??0)}"></label><label>Note<input data-rhe-ef="note" data-i="${i}" data-j="${j}" value="${esc(ef.note||'')}"></label><button type="button" data-rhe-effect-remove="${i}:${j}">Remove</button>${ef.error?`<small class="rhe-danger rhe-span12">${esc(ef.error)}</small>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}
function renderBases(){$('rheBases').innerHTML=state.bases.map((b,i)=>`<div class="rhe-base-grid"><label>Key<input data-rhe-base="key" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(b.key||'')}"></label><label>Label<input data-rhe-base="label" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(b.label||'')}"></label><label>Base value<input type="number" step="any" data-rhe-base="value" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(b.value??0)}"></label><span></span><button type="button" data-rhe-base-remove="${i}">Remove</button></div>`).join('')}
function renderFormulas(){$('rheFormulas').innerHTML=state.formulas.map((f,i)=>`<div class="rhe-formula-grid"><label>Key<input data-rhe-form="key" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(f.key||'')}"></label><label>Label<input data-rhe-form="label" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(f.label||'')}"></label><label>Formula<input data-rhe-form="formula" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(f.formula||'')}"></label><span></span><button type="button" data-rhe-form-remove="${i}">Remove</button></div>`).join('')}
function renderLinks(){const fields=detectFields();$('rheLinks').innerHTML=state.links.map((l,i)=>`<div class="rhe-field-link"><label>Calculated key<input data-rhe-link="key" data-i="${i}" value="${esc(l.key||'')}"></label><label>Sheet field<select data-rhe-link="field" data-i="${i}"><option value="">Choose detected field</option>${fields.map(f=>`<option value="${esc(f.token)}" ${f.token===l.field?'selected':''}>${esc(f.label)} (${esc(f.token)})</option>`).join('')}</select></label><button type="button" data-rhe-link-remove="${i}">Remove</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="rhe-empty">No field links.</div>'}
function renderLedger(){const c=calculate(),rows=Object.entries(c.detail);$('rheLedger').innerHTML=rows.length?`<div style="overflow:auto"><table class="rhe-table"><thead><tr><th>Key</th><th>Base / Formula</th><th>Active effects</th><th>Final</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(([k,d])=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(d.label||k)}</b><small>${esc(k)}</small></td><td>${d.formula?`<code>${esc(d.formula)}</code>`:esc(d.base)}</td><td>${['adds','mults','sets','mins','maxs'].flatMap(type=>(d[type]||[]).map(x=>`<div><span class="rhe-pill">${type}</span> ${esc(x.value)} — ${esc(x.from)}</div>`)).join('')||'—'}${d.error?`<div class="rhe-danger">${esc(d.error)}</div>`:''}</td><td><b>${Math.round((d.final+Number.EPSILON)*10000)/10000}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`:'<div class="rhe-empty">Add base values or formulas to calculate.</div>';return c}
function render(){renderCatalog();renderSelected();renderBases();renderFormulas();renderLinks();renderLedger()}
function addCatalog(id){const x=CATALOG.find(v=>v.id===id);if(!x)return;state.selected.push({id:uid(),catalogId:x.id,name:x.name,category:x.category,source:x.source,kind:x.kind,approval:x.kind==='official'?'Official/open option':'Pending DM/GM/MOL review',level:'',notes:x.summary||'',active:true,effects:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x.effects||[]))});save();renderSelected();renderLedger()}
function applyLinks(){const c=calculate(),fields=detectFields();let n=0;for(const l of state.links){const k=cleanKey(l.key),v=c.ctx[k];if(v===undefined)continue;const f=fields.find(x=>x.token===l.field);if(!f)continue;f.el.value=String(Math.round((v+Number.EPSILON)*10000)/10000);f.el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));f.el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));n++}status(`Applied ${n} calculated value${n===1?'':'s'} to sheet fields.`,'good')}
function bind(){const cats=[...new Set(CATALOG.map(x=>x.category))].sort();$('rheCategory').innerHTML='<option value="">All categories</option>'+cats.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');$('rheScope').innerHTML=`<b>${esc(META.system)}</b><br>${esc(META.scope)}<br><small>Bundled records intentionally avoid reproducing non-open proprietary descriptions. “Official index” means the option name/source is available, while the player enters mechanics from a lawfully owned source. Homebrew remains subject to DM/GM/MOL approval.</small>`;
['rheSearch','rheCategory','rheKind'].forEach(id=>$(id).addEventListener(id==='rheSearch'?'input':'change',renderCatalog));$('rheShowAll').onclick=e=>{e.currentTarget.dataset.all=e.currentTarget.dataset.all==='1'?'0':'1';e.currentTarget.textContent=e.currentTarget.dataset.all==='1'?'Limit Results':'Show All';renderCatalog()};
document.addEventListener('click',ev=>{const b=ev.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.rheAdd)addCatalog(b.dataset.rheAdd);if(b.dataset.rheRemove!==undefined){state.selected.splice(+b.dataset.rheRemove,1);save();renderSelected();renderLedger()}if(b.dataset.rheEffectAdd!==undefined){state.selected[+b.dataset.rheEffectAdd].effects.push({target:'',op:'add',value:'0',note:''});save();renderSelected()}if(b.dataset.rheEffectRemove){const [i,j]=b.dataset.rheEffectRemove.split(':').map(Number);state.selected[i].effects.splice(j,1);save();renderSelected();renderLedger()}if(b.dataset.rheBaseRemove!==undefined){state.bases.splice(+b.dataset.rheBaseRemove,1);save();renderBases();renderLedger()}if(b.dataset.rheFormRemove!==undefined){state.formulas.splice(+b.dataset.rheFormRemove,1);save();renderFormulas();renderLedger()}if(b.dataset.rheLinkRemove!==undefined){state.links.splice(+b.dataset.rheLinkRemove,1);save();renderLinks()}});
document.addEventListener('input',ev=>{const t=ev.target,i=+t.dataset.i;if(t.dataset.rheOpt){state.selected[i][t.dataset.rheOpt]=t.value;save();renderLedger()}if(t.dataset.rheEf){state.selected[i].effects[+t.dataset.j][t.dataset.rheEf]=t.value;save();renderLedger()}if(t.dataset.rheBase){state.bases[i][t.dataset.rheBase]=t.dataset.rheBase==='value'?Number(t.value):t.value;save();renderLedger()}if(t.dataset.rheForm){state.formulas[i][t.dataset.rheForm]=t.value;save();renderLedger()}if(t.dataset.rheLink){state.links[i][t.dataset.rheLink]=t.value;save()}});document.addEventListener('change',ev=>{const t=ev.target;if(t.dataset.rheActive!==undefined){state.selected[+t.dataset.rheActive].active=t.checked;save();renderLedger()}if(t.dataset.rheOpt||t.dataset.rheEf||t.dataset.rheLink)t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))});
$('rheAddManual').onclick=()=>{const name=$('rheNewName').value.trim(),category=$('rheNewCategory').value.trim();if(!name||!category){status('Manual options need both a category and name.','danger');return}state.selected.push({id:uid(),name,category,source:$('rheNewSource').value.trim(),approval:$('rheNewApproval').value,level:$('rheNewLevel').value.trim(),notes:$('rheNewNotes').value.trim(),active:true,effects:[]});$('rheNewName').value='';$('rheNewNotes').value='';save();renderSelected();renderLedger();status('Manual option added. Add its calculation effects below.','good')};
$('rheAddBase').onclick=()=>{state.bases.push({id:uid(),key:'',label:'',value:0});save();renderBases()};$('rheAddFormula').onclick=()=>{state.formulas.push({id:uid(),key:'',label:'',formula:'0'});save();renderFormulas()};$('rheAddLink').onclick=()=>{state.links.push({id:uid(),key:'',field:''});save();renderLinks()};$('rheApplyLinks').onclick=applyLinks;
$('rheExport').onclick=()=>download(`${SYSTEM_ID}-character-options-and-calculations.json`,state);$('rheCopy').onclick=async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(state,null,2));status('JSON copied.','good')}catch(e){status('Clipboard unavailable; use Export.','danger')}};$('rheImport').onchange=async ev=>{const f=ev.target.files[0];if(!f)return;try{const x=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(x.system&&x.system!==SYSTEM_ID&&!confirm(`This file was made for ${x.system}. Import anyway?`))return;state=Object.assign(state,x,{system:SYSTEM_ID});save();render();status('Imported successfully.','good')}catch(e){status('Import failed: '+e.message,'danger')}finally{ev.target.value=''}};$('rheReset').onclick=()=>{if(!confirm('Reset the options/homebrew engine for this sheet?'))return;localStorage.removeItem(STORE);state={version:2,system:SYSTEM_ID,selected:[],bases:[{id:uid(),key:'level',label:'Level / Rank / Tier',value:1}],formulas:[],links:[]};render();status('Engine reset.','good')};}

window.RulesHomebrewEngineAPI={
 system:SYSTEM_ID,
 meta:META,
 getCatalog:()=>CATALOG.map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,category:x.category,source:x.source,kind:x.kind,summary:x.summary||''})),
 addById:(id,approval)=>{const x=CATALOG.find(v=>v.id===id);if(!x)return null;const o={id:uid(),catalogId:x.id,name:x.name,category:x.category,source:x.source,kind:x.kind,approval:approval||((x.kind==='official'||x.kind==='open')?'Official/open option':'Pending DM/GM/MOL review'),level:'',notes:x.summary||'',active:true,effects:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x.effects||[]))};state.selected.push(o);save();renderSelected();renderLedger();return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o))},
 addCustom:(data)=>{data=data||{};const o={id:uid(),catalogId:'',name:String(data.name||'Advancement choice'),category:String(data.category||'Custom Advancement'),source:String(data.source||'Level/advancement wizard'),kind:'custom',approval:String(data.approval||'Pending DM/GM/MOL review'),level:String(data.level||''),notes:String(data.notes||''),active:data.active!==false,effects:Array.isArray(data.effects)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data.effects)):[]};state.selected.push(o);save();renderSelected();renderLedger();return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o))}
};
function init(){if(!$('rules-homebrew-engine'))return;load();bind();render()}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();

function flatten(o,p='',out={}){if(o==null)return out;if(Array.isArray(o)){o.forEach((v,i)=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${i}`:String(i),out));return out}if(typeof o==='object'){Object.entries(o).forEach(([k,v])=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${k}`:k,out));return out}out[norm(p)]=o;return out}
function pick(flat,...keys){for(const k of keys){const nk=norm(k);if(flat[nk]!=null&&flat[nk]!=='')return flat[nk];for(const [p,v] of Object.entries(flat))if((p===nk||p.endsWith(' '+nk))&&v!=null&&v!=='')return v}return''}

function score(a,b){a=norm(a);b=norm(b);if(!a||!b)return 0;if(a===b)return 100;if(a.includes(b)||b.includes(a))return 76;const A=new Set(a.split(' ')),B=new Set(b.split(' '));let i=0;A.forEach(x=>B.has(x)&&i++);return 50*(2*i/(A.size+B.size||1))}
function catalog(sys,cat){const d=LEGAL[sys]||{}, n=norm(cat),out=[];Object.entries(d).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});const c=CURATED[sys]||{};Object.entries(c).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});return uniq(out)}
function bestLegal(sys,cat,wanted,fallback,report,reason=''){const options=catalog(sys,cat);if(!options.length){const val=wanted||fallback||'';if(val)report.review.push(`${cat}: “${val}” could not be fully catalog-validated; retained for DM/GM/MOL review.`);return val}let best='',bestScore=-1;for(const o of options){const s=score(wanted,o);if(s>bestScore){best=o;bestScore=s}}if(wanted&&bestScore>=74)return best;const chosen=fallback&&options.find(o=>norm(o)===norm(fallback))||best||options[0];if(wanted&&norm(wanted)!==norm(chosen))report.replacements.push({category:cat,from:wanted,to:chosen,reason:reason||'No exact legal target-system match.'});return chosen}
